test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting around a circular table facing away from the center. U sits exactly between R and S. S sits to the immediate left of T. P is sitting to the immediate right of Q. Who sits to the opposite of T?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) S sits to the immediate left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a6749b53cf3f1430e9d198843c9230c499b1758bd04a7eac465553d6f264a30.png] 

2) U sits exactly between R and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1d800039bac9fad41b4f50ec98d0d84af3858201c914a110dbc2cfc962de464.png] 

3) P is sitting to the immediate right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32cc92fa98523256eebc65530209a1f48007419212cef8efa6f521635b364dcb.png] 

Here, we can see that R sits to the opposite of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R"**.
